newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: SLOVAK C.BANK SETS 3-DAY REV REPO TENDER FOR MON.
newsitem.headline: SLOVAK C.BANK SETS 3-DAY REV REPO TENDER FOR MON.

text.p: The National Bank of Slovakia (NBS) on Monday said it had set a tender for a three-day securities reverse repurchase, offering to drain an unspecified volume of market liquidity.
The NBS said in a statement that the American-style tender would have no fixed minimum rate.

According to official NBS figures, the banking sector swung into a liquidity surplus, with banks' minimum reserve demands fulfilled at 100.17 percent as of Sunday, after 98.02 percent the previous day.
At the NBS's reverse repo tender of the same maturity on January 31 the average rate rose to 17.3 percent, after 17.00 percent in the previous reverse repo tender of a similar maturity.
